title: workflow-run-record.v1
description: S055 §4.3 — one JSONL line per workflow-run state transition in progress/workflow-runs.jsonl. The MAIN LOOP is the sole writer (via _meta/workflow_dispatch.py). Doubles as the #147 enforcement hook and the #124 cost-correlation point (designed now, enforced never this cycle).

run_id.description: Recorded when state == executing (the Workflow run id).

resumed_from.description: Resume audit: an executing line carrying this after a higher plan_revision line for the same plan = a no-resume-across-amendment violation (mechanically detectable).

at.description: ISO-8601 — caller-stamped (scripts cannot read the clock).
